about: An album's grown song columns (CARD-GROW.md §9b): the mark column (Lib ♥; Full ✓ / ♥), the # column under its header, the ♥ column kept on Library Songs, and Add to Library off. Max, Press, Fill on the right card.
pass: lib: numRights all equal headerRight; hearts off/on follow the presses; the Now Playing title does not change on a ♥ press; the menu Favorite fills row 4. full: rows read check (heart on the loved song), titleSquares 0; the menu Favorite turns the ✓ to a ♥ (addShown false); the ♥ press brings the ✓ back. others: the Library Songs heads still hold ♥. add-off: stored off, Lib all hidden, Full all check. The + state is not in the demo (every song of this album is in the library).

shots.about: Step 1: Lib view. Fill the album; press a hollow ♥ twice; right-click › Favorite on another row.

steps.probe: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-view[data-cols]'); const r = v.querySelector('.lib-row'); const m = r.querySelector('.lib-row__mark').getBoundingClientRect(); const n = r.querySelector('.lib-row__num'); const nb = n.getBoundingClientRect(); const rg = document.createRange(); rg.selectNodeContents(n); const tb = rg.getBoundingClientRect(); const t = r.querySelector('.lib-row__title').getBoundingClientRect(); const a = r.querySelector('.lib-row__artist').getBoundingClientRect(); const h = v.querySelector('.lib-cols [data-col-sort=track]'); const hr = document.createRange(); hr.selectNodeContents(h); const hb = hr.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ markToDigit: Math.round(tb.left - m.right), digitToTitle: Math.round(t.left - tb.right), titleToArtist: Math.round(a.left - t.right), colGap: getComputedStyle(r).columnGap, numCell: Math.round(nb.width), header: [Math.round(hb.left), Math.round(hb.right)], markLeft: Math.round(m.left), digitRight: Math.round(tb.right) }); })()

(() => { const v = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-view[data-cols]'); if (!v) return 'no cols'; const h = v.querySelector('.lib-cols [data-col-sort=track]').getBoundingClientRect(); const n = [...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-row__num')].map(e => Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right)); return JSON.stringify({ template: v.style.getPropertyValue('--cols-template'), headerRight: Math.round(h.right), numRights: n, heads: [...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-cols__cell')].map(c => c.textContent), hearts: [...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-row')].map(r => { const b = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); return b ? (b.hidden ? 'hidden' : b.classList.contains('is-on') ? 'on' : 'off') : 'none'; }), adds: v.querySelectorAll('[data-add]').length }); })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="0"] button[data-love]'); return JSON.stringify({ on: b.classList.contains('is-on'), title: b.title, np: document.querySelector('[data-slot=np]').innerText.split('\n').slice(0,2).join(' | ') }); })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="0"] button[data-love]'); return JSON.stringify({ on: b.classList.contains('is-on'), title: b.title }); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="3"] .lib-row__title').getBoundingClientRect(); document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="3"] .lib-row__title').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 20, clientY: r.top + 5, button: 2 })); })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot=right] .lib-row')].map(r => { const b = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); return b ? (b.hidden ? 'hidden' : b.classList.contains('is-on') ? 'on' : 'off') : 'none'; }))

shots.about: Step 2: Full view. + and ✓ at rest; right-click › Favorite on a ✓ row turns it to ♥; press the ♥: ✓ again.

steps.probe: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-view[data-cols]'); if (!v) return 'no cols'; const st = (r) => { const l = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); const a = r.querySelector('[data-add]'); const vis = (e) => e && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && !e.hidden; return vis(l) ? (l.classList.contains('is-on') ? 'heart' : 'heart-off?') : vis(a) ? (a.classList.contains('is-in') ? 'check' : 'plus') : 'empty'; }; return JSON.stringify({ heads: [...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-cols__cell')].map(c => c.textContent), rows: [...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-row')].map(r => r.querySelector('.lib-row__title').textContent.trim().slice(0, 18) + ':' + st(r)), titleSquares: v.querySelectorAll('.lib-row__title [data-add]').length }); })()

steps.eval: window.__markRow = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot=right] .lib-row')].find(r => { const a = r.querySelector('[data-add]'); const l = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); return a && a.classList.contains('is-in') && l && l.hidden; })?.dataset.idx ?? null

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="' + window.__markRow + '"] .lib-row__title'); const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 20, clientY: r.top + 5, button: 2 })); })()

steps.probe: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="' + window.__markRow + '"]'); const l = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); const a = r.querySelector('[data-add]'); return JSON.stringify({ heart: !l.hidden && l.classList.contains('is-on'), title: l.title, addShown: getComputedStyle(a).display !== 'none' }); })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-row[data-idx="' + window.__markRow + '"]'); const l = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); const a = r.querySelector('[data-add]'); return JSON.stringify({ heartHidden: l.hidden, check: getComputedStyle(a).display !== 'none' && a.classList.contains('is-in') }); })()

shots.about: Step 3: Library Songs and a playlist, filled: the ♥ column is still there.

steps.probe: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .lib-view[data-cols]'); return v ? JSON.stringify([...v.querySelectorAll('.lib-cols__cell')].map(c => c.textContent)) : 'no cols: ' + document.querySelector('[data-slot=right] .panel__title')?.textContent; })()

shots.about: Step 4: Add to Library off. Lib-view cells are empty; the Full view keeps the ✓.

steps.probe: JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot=right] .lib-row')].map(r => { const a = r.querySelector('[data-add]'); const l = r.querySelector('[data-love]'); return (l && !l.hidden ? 'heart ' : '') + (a ? (getComputedStyle(a).display === 'none' || a.hidden ? 'add-hidden' : a.classList.contains('is-in') ? 'check' : 'plus') : 'no-add'); }))
